dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: Chin up! For Rukkhadivine Mushrooms...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Rukkha... divine?

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: Ahem, yes, those huge mushrooms on the trees. Everyone's seen them.

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: Huh? They're called Rukkhashava Mushrooms?

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: Fine, if you say so. It doesn't make a difference to me, it's still some divine thingy I can sell.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: Good luck! Oh, I meant for myself...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sell?

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: Yeah, don't you know? These huge mushrooms that grow in the rainforest can be sold for quite a bit in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: Seems like the Akademiya's always in need of a huge amount of these great mushrooms, so they probably wouldn't mind a nobody like me making a little money, right?

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: Anyway, my plan to resell — I mean, my plan to sell these mushrooms is perfect, but there's just one problem, The Withering.

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: *sigh* How strong must my desire to sell mushrooms be in order to get a Vision?

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: Dealing with The Withering will be a piece of cake once I have a Vision.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sell?

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: Yeah, don't you know? These huge mushrooms that grow in the rainforest can be sold for quite a good sum in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: Seems like the Akademiya's always in need of a huge amount of these great mushrooms, so they probably wouldn't mind if a nobody made a little sum off 'em, right?

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: Anyway, my plan to resell— I mean, my plan to sell these mushrooms is perfect! There's just one problem, though. The Withering.

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: Wait, what? The Withering isn't cropping up everywhere anymore? But I've heard that it's still out there in the forest... you aren't trying to trick me, are you!?

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: *sigh* Do you know how strong my desire to sell mushrooms must be in order to land a Vision?

dialogues.speaker: Tuman
dialogues.text: The Withering would be a piece of cake if I had one of those.
